_comment: Per-million-token prices for the exact models Jobby pins. USD.
Dated on purpose. A cost computed from a forgotten table reads exactly like
a cost computed from a current one, so provider_usage.py refuses a table
older than PRICE_MAX_AGE_DAYS and refuses any model past ratesExpireOn.
Two of the three models are on introductory pricing as of 2026-08-25, and
one of them expires within a week. That is the reason for per-model expiry
rather than a single table date: on 2026-09-01 the Anthropic figure below
becomes wrong while the table as a whole is still fresh.
cachedInputPerMTok is the rate for the cached SUBSET of input, not an extra
charge on top. cacheWritePerMTok is what it costs to put tokens into the
To update: change the rates, change asOf, change ratesExpireOn, and record
where the number came from in source.

gpt-5.6-luna.source: OpenAI GPT-5.6 pricing, post 2026-07-30 reduction. Cached input bills at 10% of standard. Long-context requests bill higher ($0.40/$1.80) and are NOT modelled here, so a very large context run is under-estimated.
gpt-5.6-luna.note: No announced expiry; ratesExpireOn is a review date, not a vendor deadline.

claude-sonnet-5.source: Anthropic published rates. Introductory pricing of $2.00/$10.00 runs through 2026-08-31; standard rates are $3.00/$15.00.
claude-sonnet-5.note: EXPIRES 2026-08-31. From 2026-09-01 set inputPerMTok 3.00, cachedInputPerMTok 0.30, cacheWritePerMTok 3.75, outputPerMTok 15.00. Cache multipliers are Anthropic's standard 0.1x read and 1.25x write applied to the base input rate; verify against the pricing page when updating.

gemini-3.7-flash.source: Google introductory pricing through 2026-12-31; standard rates from 2027-01-01 are $1.50/$7.50 with cached input at $0.15.
gemini-3.7-flash.note: EXPIRES 2026-12-31. From 2027-01-01 double every rate here.
